block.description:

multiple levels of notifications that are triggered after specific wait times when a check is down.
Each escalation level can send alerts to different contact groups and be repeated multiple times.

Note: This resource manages the escalation configuration for an existing check.
The check must be created first using one of the uptime_check_* resources.

down_condition.description: Condition that determines when the group check is considered DOWN. Valid values: `ANY`, `TWO`, `THREE`, `FOUR`, `FIVE`, `TEN`, `ONE_PCT`, `THREE_PCT`, `FIVE_PCT`, `TEN_PCT`, `TWENTYFIVE_PCT`, `FIFTY_PCT`, `ALL`. Numeric values (TWO-TEN) mean the group is DOWN when that many checks are down. Percentage values (ONE_PCT-FIFTY_PCT) mean the group is DOWN when that percentage of checks are down. Defaults to `ANY`.
